study type: Randomized crossover trial with qualitative interviews
outcome: Experiences with closed-loop systems (benefits and burdens)
cohort: The study participants were 16 pregnant women with Type 1 diabetes (mean age 34.1 years, mean diabetes duration 23.6 years, baseline HbA1c 51 mmol/mol).
finding: Pregnant women with Type 1 diabetes displayed complex psychosocial responses to closed-loop therapy, reporting both benefits like improved glucose control and empowerment, and burdens such as device visibility concerns and obsessive data checking, with perceptions of glycaemic response often diverging from biomedical data.
